description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'DittoAcknowledgementLabelExternalUseForbiddenException' used to signal that an internal Ditto acknowledgement label was improperly used externally. It includes constructors, JSON parsing capabilities, and a builder pattern. The class is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.acks' package.

classes.name: DittoAcknowledgementLabelExternalUseForbiddenException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException representing an error when an internal acknowledgement label is used externally. Implements AcknowledgementException, provides constructors for creating instances from label or JSON, and a method to set headers.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A nested static builder class for constructing instances of DittoAcknowledgementLabelExternalUseForbiddenException in a fluent manner.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON object representation of the exception.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated Ditto headers.
